VTUHub Self-Learning

1BAIA103 · Module 1 · Author: Dr. Lokesh M R, Professor, ISE, AJIET Mangaluru

Prepare Module 1 the VTU way

Read paraphrased notes (cited to your textbook), write answers as in the SEE paper, get a concept-wise comparison, and revise from slides or a spoken classroom lecture.

Class text: Dr. Lokesh M R, Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and its Applications, Module 1 Part A, Department of ISE, A J Institute of Engineering and Technology, Mangaluru (affiliated to VTU, Belagavi). Notes in this app are paraphrased in Indian English; figures and tables are redrawn and cited to avoid plagiarism.

Prepared under the guidance of Dr. Lokesh M R, Professor, Department of Information Science & Engineering, AJIET, Mangaluru.

1. Classroom notes

Definitions, history, types of AI, machine learning versus programming, Gardner’s intelligences — with figures, a formula box and Table 1.2.

2. VTU question paper practice

2-mark, 6-mark and 10-mark questions in the usual VTU wording. Type your answer; we score coverage against the notes.

3. Slides + lecture video

Classroom presentation and a video-style lecture (slides with browser speech). Use these when the checker asks you to revise a topic.

Topics

Classroom lecture (slides + speech)

Press Play lecture (required so the browser allows sound). Use recorded classroom audio; if a file is missing, the browser voice is used. Unmute the tab and raise device volume.

Ready.

    About the author

    Dr. Lokesh M R specialises in Cyber-Physical Systems, Artificial Immune Systems, Fault-Tolerant Computing and Multi-Agent Systems. He has published extensively in Scopus-indexed and UGC-approved journals, holds a granted patent, and currently supervises Ph.D. scholars under VTU, Belagavi.

    He has delivered invited talks at FDPs, workshops and conferences, and has contributed to KSCST- and AICTE-funded research projects. He is a Life Member of CSI and ISTE.
